{{Quote|Cut down the Jedi defenders. Then either destroy the adrenal production lines or kill the Selkath scientists operating them.|Moff [[Dracen]]|<ref name="Adrenal Shutdown" />}}
The '''adrenal synthesis factory''' was a industrial factory used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Three Families]] to synthesize [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. Located west of [[Attis Station]], the facility was staffed by a number of [[Selkath]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], and was attacked by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Quesh war]].<ref name="Adrenal Shutdown" />

==Behind the scenes==
The adrenal synthesis factory appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Adrenal Shutdown" />
